pexec.description: Top-level configuration object for pexec service

pexec.atomic_command.description: Command to execute atomically under mutex protection. Empty means no atomic command

pexec.bind_port.description: Port for remote control via INET or UNIX domain sockets. 0 disables

pexec.check_status.description: Print actual status of running jobs and exit

pexec.command.description: The main command or script to execute

pexec.connect_to.description: Port or host:port to connect to existing pexec instance for remote control

pexec.control_port.description: Control port for hypervisor daemon mode. 0 disables hypervisor mode

pexec.dump_file.description: File to dump content to stdout under mutex protection. Empty means no dump

pexec.environment.description: Environment variable NAME=VALUE to set before each execution. Empty means no extra env

pexec.error_file.description: Error file for redirecting standard error. Empty uses stderr

pexec.error_format.description: Format string for final standard error redirection. Empty uses default

pexec.fifo_queue.description: Use FIFO queue processing instead of default LIFO

pexec.input_file.description: Input file for redirecting standard input

pexec.load_interval.description: Load average interval (0, 1, 2, 1min, 5min, 15min) for limiting processes. Empty disables

pexec.log_file.description: Name of the log file. Empty disables logging

pexec.log_level.description: Logging level: debug, info, warn, error, fatal

pexec.max_procs.description: The maximal number of processes running simultaneously

pexec.multiple_command_mode.description: Allow multiple individual shell command scripts to be executed in parallel

pexec.mutex.description: Name of the mutex for atomic command execution. Empty means no mutex

pexec.name.description: Name identifier for this pexec instance

pexec.nice.description: Scheduling priority nice value for pexec and all children

pexec.omit_newlines.description: Disable automatic newlines after the output and error formats

pexec.output_file.description: Output file for redirecting standard output. Empty uses stdout

pexec.output_format.description: Format string for final standard output redirection. Empty uses default

pexec.param_column.description: Column index from which parameters should be taken if read from file

pexec.parameter_file.description: File containing the main parameter list. Empty uses inline parameters

pexec.parameters.description: List of parameters to pass to the command. Used if parameter_file is empty

pexec.remote_pexec.description: Full path of the pexec program on remote hosts. Empty means auto-detect

pexec.remote_shell.description: Remote shell path for building tunnel between local and peer hosts

pexec.save_file.description: File to save standard input to under mutex protection. Empty means no save

pexec.shell.description: Full path of the shell to be used for script execution

pexec.shell_command_mode.description: Use specified shell to interpret the command(s) instead of direct execution

pexec.treat_line_as_single.description: Treat the whole line as a single parameter if reading from file

pexec.verbose.description: Increase the log level by one
